programme.desc: Luis estaciona su carro afuera de su edificio y un franelero quiere cobrarle 20 pesos por cuidar su coche. Los vecinos hacen una junta para planear quitarlos sin que haya consecuencias.

programme.title: El reciclaje
programme.desc: Los vecinos reciben una invitación de la delegación para separar la basura. Algo muy básico: orgánica e inorgánica, Germán es el encargado de dicha misión.

programme.title: La fiesta de Morris
programme.desc: Magdalena abre una cuenta en Facebook donde presume demasiadas cosas e inclusive transmite en vivo una invitación pública para la fiesta de su nieto Morris.

programme.title: La chica del feis
programme.desc: Pedro se dedica a buscar mujeres por Facebook, y ante el asombro de Luis, conoce a una chica guapísima; Luis tiene curiosidad y decide aplicar la misma técnica para encontrar al amor de su vida.

programme.title: Como en casa
programme.desc: Silvia, desesperada por conocer hombres, renta una habitación de su departamento por medio de una aplicación; un hombre apuesto renta el cuarto, ella se enamora, pero aparece la ex novia y comienzan los problemas.

programme.title: El simulacro
programme.desc: Un temblor llega a la ciudad sacudiendo todos los departamentos de los vecinos. Luis les propone a los vecinos llevar a una persona de Protección civil para prepararlos ante una emergencia.

programme.title: El origen
programme.desc: Morris está en la etapa de las dudas y pregunta a sus padres cómo conquistar al amor de su vida. Alejandra y Rocko deciden contarle una historia de amor: el relato de cómo se conocieron.

programme.title: El wifi
programme.desc: Silvia instala internet de alta velocidad en su departamento, sin embargo su conexión es muy lenta; lo que no sabe es que sus vecinos saben la contraseña y todos se conectan a su red.

programme.title: El método
programme.desc: Lorena está cansada de que Frankie no consiga trabajo y a éste se le ocurre una gran idea: poner una academia de actuación basada en el Método Rivers.

programme.title: El click
programme.desc: Arturo llora porque su familia es pobre y Lorena lo consuela, Germán y Pedro creen que son amantes. Magda encuentra una nota de amor y las cosas se enredan más de la cuenta.

programme.title: La separación
programme.desc: Lorena trata de seducir a Frankie, pero él la rechaza porque está escribiendo un guión, ella lo insulta y él decide irse de su casa. Finalmente Benito regresa a casa después de 10 años.

programme.title: Benito regresa
programme.desc: Benito está de regreso después de mucho tiempo. Lalo invita a salir a Silvita y comienza a planear su futuro. A los López Pérez les cortan los servicios y dejan sin luz a media colonia.

programme.title: Los candidatos
programme.desc: Silvia y Arturo compiten para ser el presidente del vecindario. Alejandra y Rocko se preocupan porque creen que han perdido su juventud y personalidad.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

The episode captures the excitement, surprises, and unforgettable first impressions that kick off his adventure across the country.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Rides a Flying Car!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed steps into the future as he takes a ride in a real flying car, experiencing one of the most advanced forms of transportation ever created. From witnessing cutting-edge technology up close to reacting to the thrill of lifting off the ground, Speed gets a firsthand look at what could shape the future of travel. Blending innovation, excitement, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unforgettable experience unlike anything he’s encountered before.

programme.title: iShowSpeed & Zac Wang Recreate Karate Kid Scenes!

From legendary training exercises to cinematic recreations inspired by the classic film, the duo puts their skills, discipline, and determination to the test. Blending action, comedy, and cultural discovery, the episode captures an unforgettable adventure as Speed steps into the role of a real-life Karate Kid.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In Barbados!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Barbados for the first time, experiencing the island’s vibrant culture, beautiful scenery, and unique energy. From exploring local hotspots and meeting residents to taking in the food, music, and atmosphere, Speed immerses himself in everything Barbados has to offer. Blending curiosity, adventure, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unfiltered journey through one of the Caribbean’s most iconic destinations.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In Trinidad & Tobago
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Trinidad & Tobago for the first time, experiencing the unique culture, energy, and spirit of the twin-island nation. From exploring the streets and connecting with locals to experiencing the music, food, and everyday life, Speed immerses himself in everything the country has to offer. Blending curiosity, adventure, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unfiltered journey through one of the Caribbean’s most vibrant and culturally rich destinations.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In PuertoRico!

programme.title: iShowSpeed Explores Inside The Pyramids Of Egypt!

programme.desc: Bobby exploring a destroyed tunnel, rescuing rare fish from polluted waters, and relocating them to safer environments.

programme.title: I Found a Monster Living in a Green Slime Pond...
programme.desc: Bobby and team find various hidden aquatic creatures, including blue crawfish and African cichlids, while exploring green slime ponds.

programme.title: I Found Dolphins in a Sewer!
programme.desc: Bobby explores sewers, discovering rare fish, a tiger salamander, and a shocking 'dolphin' fish, then returns home to rehome the creatures and check fish traps.

programme.title: I Found a Sewer FILLED with Monsters!
programme.desc: A nighttime adventure where electric blue crawfish are caught in a creek and explored a creepy tunnel, encountering a snakehead and an alligator.

programme.title: I Discovered Monsters Living in a Hidden Tunnel...
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned bridge, Bobby catches various exotic fish and baby snapping turtles, showcasing diverse aquatic life and adding them to his home aquariums.

programme.title: I Found Live Animals in a Pet Store Dumpster!
programme.desc: Bobby explores pet store dumpsters to find live animals like fish, turtles, snakes, frogs, and lobsters, rescuing them and planning to provide them with better homes.

programme.title: I Found Monsters Living in an Abandoned Pool!
programme.desc: Bobby and friends explore an abandoned pool filled with fish, catching and relocating them to a lake while reacting to the unexpected finds.

programme.title: I Found Axolotls in an Abandoned Pond!
programme.desc: Bobby rescues axolotls and a variety of exotic fish from an abandoned pond, encountering surprising and rare species, and relocates them to new homes for safety.

programme.title: I Caught the Monster Attacking My Fish!
programme.desc: Bobby rescues fish from his pond after discovering a 4-foot ripsaw catfish attacking them. Rehousing includes freshwater sharks, sturgeons, and exotic catfish.

programme.desc: Bobby drains a pond full of mystery fish, finding unexpected goldfish, turtles, eels, and even an iridescent shark, relocating them to new habitats.

programme.title: I Caught Rare Fish For My Aquarium!
programme.desc: Bobby shows the process of netting and trapping various fish from a creek to create a temporary fish tank ecosystem, later transferring them to his home aquarium.

programme.title: I Found an Alligator in a Hidden Tunnel...
programme.desc: Bobby and team explore a hidden tunnel full of rare fish and encounters an alligator. They catch fish, plan more explorations, and face thrilling and dangerous moments.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Conservation Wins and Losses with Senator Martin Heinrich | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 817 - 12 - 817
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with New Mexico Senator Martin Heinrich, Ryan Callaghan, and Randall Williams. Topics discussed: Corner crossing and the Supreme Court ruling; stream access; the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, mining, and caribou; the Roadless Rule; where to develop and not develop renewables; relative bipartisan support for nuclear energy; reintroducing pronghorn back to an area of New Mexico; the breadth of the coalition that came together around keeping public lands in public hands; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Clay's Utah Mountain Lion Hunt | "12 in '26" Ep. 855 - 12 - 855
programme.desc: Clay Newcomb answers your questions and breaks down his Utah mountain lion hunt captured in MeatEater's brand new "12 in '26" film series. He hunts with mules and hounds in the mountains, testing his fortitude in some seriously steep and rugged terrain.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - How To Translate Animal Language | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 838 - 12 - 838
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with naturalist, writer, and sculptor George Bumann, Brody Henderson, Phil Taylore, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: George's book, Eavesdropping On Animals; Animal vocalizations; subscribe to the new Bear Grease YouTube channel; laws on game retrieval; just how pungent skunk odor really is; stay tuned for MeatEater TV's new "12 in 26" hunt series, starting with Jani's Manitoba bear episode; how absurd it is that guys called better than turkeys themselves; what various raven calls mean; how the birds gossip about everything; wolf howling and squirrel chirping translations; all the animals are talking about and know you; silence as the most important alarm that exists; The Yellowstone Summit; and more. Order George's book EAVESDROPPING ON ANIMALS here: https://www.georgebumann.com/gb/eavesdropping-on-animals/ Register for The Yellowstone Summit here: https://www.yellowstonesummit.com/

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Osceola, Native American Slavery, and The Seminole Wars | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 832 - 12 - 832
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with author Jamie Holmes, Randall Williams, Brody Henderson, Phil Taylor, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: Jamie's new book, The Free and the Dead: The Untold Story of the Black Seminole Chief, the Indigenous Rebel, and America's Forgotten War is out; deep archival research; the evidence base and when the notes section of the book is almost as long as the book itself; the complexity of stories about the Seminole Wars; turning what you know on its head; the environment of interior Florida; what enslavement meant to the tribes; who were the black Seminole people?; the relationship between Osceola and Abraham; and more.

programme.title: Angel On The Line
programme.desc: Mary and her very attractive friend, Lois, go to the Hot Line Club, a singles club with a phone at each table. The phone rings and the caller asks to speak to Lois. He then tells her that she is so pretty he has to kill her. Lois leaves the club. She is followed, and in an effort to escape, runs in front of a car, is hit and killed. Mary calls in the Angels to investigate. They all go to the Hot Line Club. The entertainment is hypnotist, Margo, who gets Kelly into the act. Kelly later gives Margo her business card. Afterwards, Kelly sits with Mary. Soon the phone rings and Mary answers. The voice asks to speak with Kelly. When she gets on, he tells her that she is so pretty he has to kill her. Mary recognizes it as the same voice that called Lois. When Kelly leaves the club, she sees a car following her and writes down the license number. Later she is contacted by a man named Edward Ford who says he is a writer. He tells Kelly that Margo gave him her name and number. They arrange to meet for lunch. Kelly is suspicious of him and contacts the other Angels who find out that his car is registered in the name of Paul Factor. Kelly leaves the luncheon and goes back to the Hot Line Club in an effort to get information about Ford from Margo. When Margo arrives, she takes Kelly out to a back alley, pulls a knife and tries to stab her. The Angels and Bosley arrive in time to rescue her. During the struggle, Margo's wig and false eyelashes come off, revealing "her" to be Edward Ford who really is Paul Factor.

programme.title: Chorus Line Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Ruth Traina, who has invested $150,000 in a Darian Mason Production, to investigate the disappearance of two of the best dancers. Kelly auditions a job as a dancer; Julie is her agent/manager and Kris poses as a writer/critic doing a story on Mason. Another of the better dancers, Nancy, disappears after being caught going through Mason's files. Mason then catches Kris going through his files and threatens her. The Angels and Bosley find that Mason has deliberately hired theinexperienced and gotten rid of the good ones to make the audition a failure, since he can't possibly pay off all of his investors. Kelly and Julie come to Kris' rescue. They then find and free the three missing dancers. The cast, including Kelly, decide to go through the audition since they feel that they owe it to themselves to at least try. The Las Vegas executives they audition for express great interest in the dancers.

programme.title: Stuntwoman Angels
programme.desc: Motion picture executive Jonathan Tobias hires Bosley and the Angels to track down someone dressed as one of Robin Hood's Merry Men who has been shooting arrows into studio personnel. Tobias knows that the arrows are aimed at him when his chauffeur is hit. Charlie arranges for the Angels to enroll in stunt school and then go to work as stuntwomen on a picture called "Marian and her Merry Maids" -- a bad remake of an old Errol Flynn classic. The Angels become friendly with one of the maids, Ellen Travers, and her husband, Jeff. Ellen, a former rodeo queen, has become enamored with movies. Jeff is trying desperately to get her to quit the movies and go back home with him. Bosley learns that one of the security guards, Jake Webner, was in the original picture with his idol -- Errol Flynn. Ellen Travers is hit with an arrow while driving a wagon during one of the scenes. It is Jake who has been dressing as Robin Hood's man with the bow and arrow, trying to get to Tobias because he feels that Tobias has been making bad movies. Jake is eventually caught while shooting an arrow into the director's foot. However, Bosley discovers that Jake was on guard duty when Ellen Travers was shot. Her husband, Jeff, who was trying to scare her into giving up movies, really shot her. Jake and Jeff are both taken into custody.

programme.title: Attack Angels
programme.desc: Edward Tustin, head of a group trying to take over Western Techtronics, engages efficiency expert, Dr. John Reardon of Executive Assistants, to have the four members of Techtronics who oppose his takeover killed. Reardon has hypnotized three girls for the job; Darlene Warren, Cynthia Weaver and Francine Miller. He uses motivational Pavlovian and Sensory conditioning and the subjects kill without fear, passion or memory. After the Chairman of the Board and a Vice President of Techtronics are killed and Francine Miller's body is found with them, the Angels are hired by company President, Steve Briggs. Briggs realizes he is next on the list. Kelly and Kris join Techtronics as executive trainees and Julie applies as Executive Assistant. She is hypnotized by Dr. Reardon, who uses flashing strobe effects, a candle and a water tank. After Julie has become completely programmed, she is sent to kill Briggs and almost succeeds when the suspicious Kelly and Kris arrive and save him. Julie is then deprogrammed by a doctor who explains that fire and water are two of the strongest hypnotic symbols. Reardon, Tustin and their associates are taken into custody.

programme.title: Angel On A Roll
programme.desc: After twelve different banks have been robbed of a quarter of a million dollars in hundred dollar bills, the Angels are called in to investigate. All the banks have the same type of automatic teller. Ted Markham, a computer and electronics genius who designed and installed the automatic tellers, has quit his job. Kris volunteers to become acquainted with Markham with the intention of obtaining some of the bills so that the serial numbers may be traced. Kris follows Markham to a poker parlor where he takes out a stack of $100 bills and with the help of a wrist calculator is a big winner. Ted and Kris are attracted to each other and they take off for Las Vegas in Kris' car. While in Las Vegas, Kris manages to get some of the bills away from Ted. She phones the serial numbers to Bosley and soon learns that they are part of the missing money. After Ted has won $300,000, he is asked to leave Las Vegas by the casino owner. On the way out of town, Ted stops at a bank while Kris waits in the car. When they arrive back in California, at the spot where Ted left his car, Kelly, Julie and Bosley are waiting with the police to take Ted into custody. Bosley then finds that Ted is free to go due to the fact that when he deposited the money in the bank in Las Vegas, he had paid back each of the twelve banks with interest, and they will not prosecute. Even though Ted and Kris have strong feelings for each other, they realize their relationship would not be the same -- so they sadly part.

programme.title: Moonshinin' Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are sent to Moonshine country in the Deep South to investigate problems between long-feuding bootlegging families, the Bartletts and the Catlins. Son, Bobby Dan Bartlett, who is injured trying to get a shipment of whiskey to market and Catlin daughter, Melinda, are in love, much to the displeasure of both families. Kris gets a job with the Catlins as a still master. Kelly gets a job with the Bartletts as a driver. Julie takes a job as a waitress at Joe's Diner. Bosley poses as a wealthy southerner trying to buy both families out. The Angels find that the shootings and hijackings have not been done by the families, but by a group headed by Max Lacy from New York. Lacy is trying to corner the whiskey market and gain political control of the state. The Angels are able to stop a gunfight between the family elders, Hawkshaw Bartlett and Bluford Catlin, and show them who the real culprits are. Max Lacy and his group are arrested. Hobby Dan and Melinda are happily reunited.

programme.title: He Married An Angel
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Barbara Stone and her sister, Jane, to track down John Thornwood. He has swindled them out of $100,000 by promising to marry Jane and persuading her to invest money in a phony South American oil exploration venture. The Angels track Thornwood to an apartment complex. Kris, posing as a confidence artist, rents the apartment next to his. Bosley poses as a Texan from whom she has swindled $50,000. Kris and Thornwood become friends, and he confesses to her that he has another scheme going. Kelly and Julie follow Thornwood to a museum owned by plain-looking Monica Thackery. Thornwood is posing as Professor Thornwood and has asked the smitten Monica to marry him and deposit $150,000 to an account supposedly for importing some pieces of art. Charlie, Bosley and the Angels find that Monica is the daughter of an eastern syndicate head, Joe Fenell. Thornwood is planning a phony marriage ceremony with Monica and then to withdraw the money and run. The Angels trick Thornwood into a real marriage with Monica because she is so much in love with him. They figure that her father will keep Thornwood in line. Thornwood, finding that he has been tricked, tries to escape, but is caught by Joe Fenell and his henchmen. Fenell warns him to be good to Monica or else. Thornwood knows that he has to stick with Monica and be a good husband...or else.

programme.title: Taxi Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are called in to investigate, when Tom Archer, who owns a cab company with his wife Laurie, is badly burned as his cab explodes. Laurie Archer reveals that they have been getting threatening phone calls and someone obviously is trying to put them out of business. Kris takes a job as a waitress across the street from the cab garage. Julie becomes a driver and Kelly, a dispatcher. Two employees, Jake Barnett, ex-con, and Sarge, a shell-shocked hallucinating casualty of World War II, are both under suspicion. It seems Tom Archer had fired Sarge and advised him to go to the V.A. hospital for treatment. Later, Julie's cab catches fire and she and her passenger escape just in time. Jake advises Julie that Sarge's ex-wife was killed by a cab and he is starting the fires to put Tom and Laurie's cab company out of business. The Angels go to Sarge's room, but he escapes through a window, goes up on the roof, and tries to jump to the next building. He misses and is killed. The Angels then find out that Sarge's wife was not killed by a cab. Instead, the woman who Jake lived with was the victim of the accident. Julie takes Jake out in her cab with a tape recorder on -- the others listening -- and gets Jake to admit that he is really the guilty one. He takes off in the cab -- Kris arrives and she and Julie pursue him and trap him at the Los Angeles River. The other Angels praise Julie for her driving expertise and she admits she learned it from an old boyfriend in her neighborhood who drove stolen cars.

programme.desc: After some wheeling and dealing and mending a riff between Mr. Kimball and his mother, Oliver (Eddie Albert) finally has a phone installed, but the Hooterville Phone Company installs it directly outside his bedroom window...on top of the phone pole.

programme.title: Parity Begins At Home
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheat�because of Mr. Haney.

programme.title: Lisa Has A Calf
programme.desc: The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

programme.title: The Wedding Anniversary
programme.desc: It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

programme.title: What Happened In Scranton
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

programme.title: Give Me Land, Lots Of Land
programme.desc: When Oliver's neighbor, Mr. Watson, decides to do some traveling, Oliver (Eddie Albert) buys the farm which adjoins his property, but not the house on it. Lisa (Eva Gabor) misunderstands and thinks the beautiful farmhouse is their new home.

programme.title: I Didn't Raise My Husband To Be A Fireman
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers the only requirement to join the Hooterville Valley Fire Department is that he must play a musical instrument. Meanwhile Lisa (Eva Gabor) tries her hand at cooking something besides "hotscakes" for breakfast.

programme.title: Lisa Bakes A Cake
programme.desc: Believing he will never get a moment's peace, Oliver (Eddie Albert) is annoyed when Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts a listing in the new phone book: "Oliver Douglas, Attorney at Law"�but it is a different story when no one calls for his services.

programme.title: The Price Of Apples
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s apple crop is ready to be harvested, and he decides to take them to market himself and make a killing. Of course, getting to market before the price drops proves a little more difficult than Oliver anticipates.

programme.title: What's In A Name?
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) becomes enamored of Mr. Kimball (Alvy Moore), the county agent. However, though she feminizes herself and gets all gussied up, he refuses to go out with a girl named Ralph. Can Oliver solve the situation legally?

programme.title: The Day Of Decision
programme.desc: Six months is up! Now, Lisa (Eva Gabor) gets to decide whether she and Oliver (Eddie Albert) will remain on the farm or go back to New York and their Park Avenue lifestyle! Will this be the final straw for Green Acres?

programme.title: The Deputy
programme.desc: Sam Drucker (Frank Cady) is leaving on a much-needed two-week vacation and talks Oliver (Eddie Albert) into assuming his duties as deputy sheriff. But Oliver soon learns enforcing the law isn't quite as easy as it looks.

programme.title: The Ballad Of Molly Turgiss
programme.desc: Whatever you do, don't say her name and especially while playing checkers down at Drucker's! An old hag named Molly Turgiss (Renie Riano), who died twenty years before the Douglases (Eddie Albert, Eva Gabor) came to town, might be haunting them.

programme.title: Never Look A Gift Tractor In The Mouth
programme.desc: It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get him�until the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.

programme.title: Send A Boy To College
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Eb (Tom Lester) has a way with sick animals after Eb cures Arnold, the pig, and Alice, the chicken, and offers to put him through veterinary college. But will life in Green Acres ever be the same without Ed?!

programme.title: Horse? What Horse?
programme.desc: A horse follows Oliver (Eddie Albert) home, but every time he tries to show it to his wife, the horse disappears. Lisa (Eva Gabor) assumes that her husband is imagining things�and as more animals show up, Oliver begins to think so too.

programme.title: The Rains Came
programme.desc: Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) takes Oliver (Eddie Albert) to Pixley Superior Municipal Court and sues him for non-payment of a vital contract over the little matter of some rain�or lack thereof. Does Mr. Haney know who he's up against? Does Oliver?

programme.title: Uncle Fester, Tycoon

programme.title: Fester Goes On A Diet

programme.title: Ophelia Finds Romance
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: Pugsley's Allowance

programme.title: Happy Birthday, Grandma Frump
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: Morticia, The Decorator
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: Ophelia Visits Morticia
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: Addams Cum Laude
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: Cat Addams
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: Lurch's Little Helper
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Policy

programme.title: Jakob Nowell of Sublime on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Jakob Nowell, frontman of Sublime and Jakob’s Castle, joins Joel Madden for an open conversation on legacy, sobriety, and finding identity beyond fame. Jakob reflects on growing up surrounded by music, his father’s influence, building his own sound, and the healing power of honesty in art.

programme.title: Pierre Bouvier of Simple Plan on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Simple Plan frontman Pierre Bouvier joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on balancing family and touring life, creative longevity, and the band’s continued success. They revisit their early 2000s pop-punk roots, reflect on 20+ years of friendship, and discuss Simple Plan’s special edition book with Alternative Press as the band enters one of its strongest eras yet.

programme.title: Give It Up: The Greatest Concert of Comedy Songs
programme.desc: Filmed live in Los Angeles, Avery Pearson hosts a one-night-only comedy concert blending music, satire, and stand-up. Featuring Jay Pharoah, Arden Myrin, Adam Ray, Beth Stelling, Luke Null, JR De Guzman, Jeremiah Watkins, Josh Adam Meyers, and more, the show delivers original comedy songs and musical parodies about life, fame, and delusion.

programme.title: Jimmy Eat World: 20th Anniversary of “Futures” Live From Phoenix
programme.desc: Jimmy Eat World return to their hometown for a one-night celebration of the 20th anniversary of Futures, performing the album front to back at The Van Buren in Phoenix, Arizona. Featuring fan-favorite tracks (“Futures,” “Just Tonight…,” “Work,” “The World You Love,” “Pain,” “Drugs or Me”) and special hometown moments from the band.

programme.title: Reggie Watts: Never Mind
programme.desc: Comedian, musician, and improvisational mastermind Reggie Watts takes the stage in Los Angeles for a performance that bends space, sound, and sense itself. Blending stand-up, music, and live looping, Never Mind explores technology, nostalgia, and the absurdity of modern life through spontaneous humor and sonic experimentation. Both futuristic and deeply human, this live special showcases Watts’ singular ability to find rhythm and meaning in chaos.

programme.title: Brandon Lake on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: GRAMMY-winning singer-songwriter Brandon Lake joins Joel Madden to talk balancing fame and family, using music to share his relationship with faith, and previewing his upcoming album King of Hearts. He opens up about hiring a performance/health coach for life on tour, dialing in nutrition and strength training, life on a new South Carolina farm, growing up in church and learning guitar, and the joy of community in music—from a viral onstage “Higher” moment to swapping stories about Creed and meeting Scott Stapp.

programme.title: King 810: Memoirs Livestream From The Crofoot Ballroom

programme.title: THE PRICE AIN'T RIGHT
programme.desc: Welcome back to The Price Ain't Right — the only game show where you get punished for guessing the wrong price. The members of AMP play to guess the correct price, or face a punishment from the WHEEL OF MISFORTUNE.

programme.title: CONTAINER WARS
programme.desc: The guys hit the auction block looking for hidden treasure in old, abandoned storage units. Split into 3 teams with a $1000 budget each, they compete to flip their units for the most profit.

programme.title: $3M CAR COLLECTION
programme.desc: The AMP guys show off their combined $3,000,000 car collection. Some members have more cars than others, but with a total like that, you know every ride is worth the watch.

programme.title: GUESS THE COUNTRY
programme.desc: AMP puts their geographical knowledge to the test. Eight contestants from around the world step in, and the guys have to guess where each one is from using only the smallest clues.

programme.title: WORST PERSON EVER
programme.desc: How do you decide the Worst Person Ever? AMP brings in contestants with the most outrageous backstories and lets the guys vote on who takes the crown.

programme.title: GUESS THE STRIPPER
programme.desc: Six women walk into the AMP studio — one of them is a real stripper. The guys run through a series of challenges and questions to figure out which one.

programme.title: GUESS THE WHITE PERSON
programme.desc: This time, the guys are the contestants — hiding alongside one white person and trying to trick a jury of white people into picking the wrong one.

programme.title: GUESS THE IMPOSTER
programme.desc: Could you pick a celebrity out of a crowd if you'd never seen them before? AMP brings in strangers who've never heard of them and challenges the guys to impersonate each other — convincing total strangers they are who they claim to be.

programme.title: GUESS THE FELON
programme.desc: Five actors, one real ex-felon. AMP has to figure out who's actually done time. After rounds of questions, the guys whittle down the contestants until they land on who they believe is the true felon.

programme.title: LAST TO LEAVE THE YACHT
programme.desc: How long would you stay on a yacht if the last one left gets to keep it? That's the challenge AMP takes on, competing through a series of boat-themed games to see who wants it most.

programme.title: DIRTY JOBS
programme.desc: AMP puts the age-old debate to rest — is streaming actually harder than a 9 to 5? The guys go to work and compete through real challenges to find the answer.

programme.title: DRIVER'S ED
programme.desc: The guys become driving coaches. AMP splits into 3 teams of two, each tasked with taking their student driver through the full AMP driving checklist.

programme.title: ESCAPE OR DIE
programme.desc: Duke, Agent, and Chris get thrown into a real-life Zombie simulator based on Resident Evil, sent into an abandoned building to rescue Kai Cenat from the evil doctor Gideon.

programme.title: EXTREME HIDE AND SEEK
programme.desc: BREAKING NEWS — AMP has been kidnapped and brought to a remote facility. The guys have to hide from their captors and escape with their lives in this extreme IRL hide and seek challenge.

programme.title: PLAYGROUND GAMES
programme.desc: AMP brings back classic childhood games with an IRL twist. From floor is lava to musical chairs, the guys go head-to-head to see who is the ultimate playground champion.

programme.title: HIBACHI WARS
programme.desc: The boys hit the hibachi grill, trained by real Master Hibachi Chefs on everything they need to make a 5-star meal. Then they compete head-to-head to see which team cooks it better.

programme.title: WOULD YOU RATHER IRL
programme.desc: Would you rather get slapped in the face or eat a live bug? AMP takes Would You Rather to the next level, competing through real challenges where every choice has real consequences.

programme.title: TRY NOT TO LAUGH: FACE OFF
programme.desc: Time for another Try Not To Laugh challenge. The guys compete face to face trying to make each other crack. Each round brings a new prompt — find out who can hold their laugh the longest.

programme.title: I Bought a Haunted House
programme.desc: Unspeakable and the gang buy a haunted house and face spooky surprises and frightening chaos!

programme.title: I Escaped 1,000 Layers of Cardboard
programme.desc: Unspeakable and the gang try to escape 1,000 layers of cardboard using crazy tools and tricks!

programme.title: I Sold My House!
programme.desc: The crew looks back on memories.

programme.title: How to Treat Men Better
programme.desc: Are modern gender dynamics leaving men feeling ‘castrated’? While men are often blamed for today’s social problems, far less attention is given to how shifting expectations of women and relationships may also shape male identity. What role do women play in this dynamic—and how can it be improved? Expect to learn how important it is for women to seem impressed or giddy or appreciative of their partner, how women can appear more receptive or appreciative, why men are being emasculated by women, how women can stop castrating men and much more…

programme.title: How to Defeat Your Stress, Anxiety & Inaction
programme.desc: If motivation can’t be trusted, what should you rely on instead? Bestselling author and top podcaster Mel Robbins explains why discipline and emotional control are the real keys to success, and how to build the mindset needed to follow through when it counts. Expect to learn why we cling to control even when we know it makes us miserable and why we focus on things we can't control, how to better deal with the judgment of others, where self-compassion comes from, how to get a grip on your anxiety and ADHD, what ""Let Them"" theory means and how to employ it, where self-compassion actually comes from and much more...

programme.title: The Personal Pain of Country Music
programme.desc: Odds are, your favorite country song wasn’t written by the person singing it; it was probably written by HARDY (or someone in his writing circle, maybe). So how did a Mississippi country boy become one of Nashville’s most powerful behind-the-scenes writers and producers? Expect to learn what HARDY’s philosophy for his career and life is, what most people do not understand about how the Nashville scene works, how to balance the unique tension between being a songwriter and an artist, the story of the bus crash that almost killed HARDY, how to use vulnerability and turn it into a strength and much more…

programme.title: Uncertain About Your Relationship? You Need This…
programme.desc: How do you know if you’re with the right person — or if you're just telling yourself you are? If you’re questioning the relationship more than enjoying it, Matthew Hussey might have the clarity you need. So what does finding your person actually look like, and what signs should you pay attention to? Expect to learn how to know when it’s time to leave a relationship, the 5 questions to ask yourself if you’re unsure about your relationship, why people struggle so hard with letting others go, how women can best support their man and visa versa, how important attractiveness is to both men and women in a successful relationship, ways to learnt to be more vulnerable and much more…

programme.title: The Case Against Condoms & Fake Friendship
programme.desc: Why do humans act so complicated? We’re simple creatures, farts are funny, everyone does awkward stuff, yet we all pretend we don’t. Maybe life gets better when you lean into the weird instead of hiding it. So how do you embrace being different and find the fun instead of stressing about it? Expect to learn how Rick’s brain works, what his favourite show and jokes are and how they shaped him, the top things that are difficult to look cool while doing, why using "condoms" with friends are useless, how to handle our people pleasing tendencies for good, why humans are so hard to interact with at times, the awkward feelings of becoming intimate with someone, the biggest message Rick Glassman wants to give out in the world and much more…
